text.description_html:
Acorn Flower Surfboard Hand Painted Cabinet Pull

Acorn's Flower Surfboard Cabinet Pull is perfect for bringing the surfer spirit to your home. The Flower Cabinet Pull measures 5-1/2" long and 1-1/4" high, making it perfect for all sorts of applications, be it in the kitchen, the bathroom, or on an end table in the living room. Shaped like a surfboard, this ceramic pull is hand painted to mimic the Aloha spirit of the beach. It is available in two colors, each of which is available in large and small sizes. The large pulls have a 4" center to center while the small pulls have a 3" center to center.

Features of the Flower Surfboard Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: ceramic
  • Each design is hand painted on ceramic.
  • Can be mounted horizontally or vertically.
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.

Available Types:

    PPHYP - Large Light Green Ceramic Pull With Blue Flowers:
    • Center to Center: 4"
    • Overall Length: 5-1/2"
    • Width: 1-1/4"

    PPJYP - Small Light Green Ceramic Pull With Blue Flowers:
    • Center to Center: 3"
    • Overall Length: 4-7/8"
    • Width: 1-3/16"

    PPFYP - Large Light Orange Ceramic Pull With Dark Orange Flowers:
    • Center to Center: 4"
    • Overall Length: 5-1/2"
    • Width: 1-1/4"

    PPGYP - Small Light Orange Ceramic Pull With Dark Orange Flowers:
    • Center to Center: 3"
    • Overall Length: 4-7/8"
    • Width: 1-3/16"

Sold Individually. Due to the hand painted nature of this product, the colors will vary slightly.
